description: Run a read-only telegram CLI command on the user's account, e.g. ["inbox","-n","10"], ["read","@user","-n","20"], ["search","invoice","--chat","Work"]. args[0] is the command; chats are an ID, @username, "me" or a title. Output is compact text (add "--json" for JSON). Add "--full" (read/get/search/inbox/watch) for complete per-message stats: views, forwards, full reactions, comments, flags, media detail. watch needs -t or -n. A new public-post search (channels.SearchPosts) may use up the free daily search quota.

args.description: CLI argv, command first, one item per word: ["read","@user","-n","20"]

name: telegram_read

exitCode.description: The CLI's exit code (0 ok, 1 runtime, 2 usage, 4 writes off, 5 not logged in)

output.description: The result as the model reads it: the command's output (its JSON as text with --json), an error or what to do next. The same text as content.

status.description: approval_required, human_required, nothing_to_do, done, open_page or ready

stderr.description: What the CLI printed on stderr

title: Read Telegram
